registry_rules: track_names[] is the canonical source for every Strand.tracks map key; syntax alone never admits a name.
New writes MUST use an active row. Unknown, deprecated, duplicate, or owner-unresolvable names fail closed with schema_violation.
owner.kind=schema requires schema_ref to resolve to an effective reference registered by schema_registry; owner.kind=profile requires profile_id to resolve in conformance-profiles.json.
Profiles MAY add a TrackName only by adding an owned row here, regenerating track-name-registry.json, and updating the versioned Strand schema TrackName enum in the same protocol change.
